address: Qt 'Address:' label beside the address field; the emtk address field has the same hint text ('docs/page.md#anchor, src:path#symbol, cite:key, URL or search') and a tooltip instead of a label.
ask: Qt 'Ask' toolbar toggle that shows the question panel; the emtk app shows the same panel as the 'Ask Docs' tab beside 'Documentation'.
askthedocs: Header 'Ask the docs' of the Qt question panel; the emtk panel is the 'Ask Docs' tab.
edit: Qt authoring 'Edit' toggle; emtk 'Source' button (toggles to 'Read') above the page, same action.
save: Qt authoring 'Save'; emtk 'Save' appears beside 'Read' while the source is being edited (not drawn in the default state the inventory records).
markreviewed: Qt authoring 'Mark reviewed'; emtk 'Mark human reviewed' in the Authoring tools row (drawn when Authoring tools is on and the page is tracked).
ai-reviewed: Qt authoring 'AI-reviewed'; emtk 'Mark AI reviewed' in the Authoring tools row (authoring state, after_authoring_1200x800.png).
show: Qt 'Show:' label of the review-filter combo; the emtk combo above the tree (authoring state) has a tooltip instead of a label.
allpages: Entry of the review-filter combo; emtk combo above the tree in the authoring state lists All pages / Unreviewed / AI-reviewed / Human-reviewed / Stale.
unreviewed: Entry of the review-filter combo; present in the emtk combo (authoring state).
reviewed: Entry 'Reviewed' of the review-filter combo; emtk 'Human-reviewed' (authoring state).
stale: Entry of the review-filter combo; present in the emtk combo (authoring state).
developerdocs: Qt authoring 'Developer docs' toggle; emtk 'Developer docs' checkbox in the Authoring tools row (authoring state; test_developer_docs_toggle_lists_development_pages).
